reasons: Both answers refuse to trust the customer-stated balance, list the right preconditions (ledger balance, pending transactions/holds, linked products, ownership), and propose moving validation into close_account with typed refusals. B adds substantive points A lacks: prompt instructions are not a control, the time-of-check/time-of-use gap that server-side validation closes, firing the email from the backend, and a useful caveat that the fee schedule in the prompt must stay in sync with the live source. A's fallback of a combined read tool and its summary table are good, but overall B gives slightly deeper and more actionable guidance.
